purpose: Track portfolio-level development tooling that can close feedback loops without inventing availability or committing secrets.

capabilities.benefit: Structured repository, PR, issue, Actions, and security context for local coding agents.
capabilities.security: Use OAuth or a least-privilege PAT outside version control; never commit credentials.

capabilities.benefit: Browser-level verification for Knowledge Engine Web and other web surfaces using accessibility snapshots and deterministic interaction.
capabilities.security: Do not persist authenticated browser state or private screenshots into repositories unless explicitly sanitized and authorized.

capabilities.benefit: Connect GitHub events to sanitized cross-repository orchestration without replacing deterministic GitHub Actions or the DoWork scheduler.
capabilities.security: Version-controlled workflows stay inactive and credential-free; public HTTPS ingress, runtime credentials, and activation require explicit review.
capabilities.evidence: n8n workflow manifest, fail-closed Python validator, tests, local-only Docker bootstrap, and orchestrator evidence-intake workflow.
capabilities.promotion_rule: Verify local runtime, security audit, least-privilege GitHub credential, and one real webhook route before expanding mutation authority.

capabilities.scope: project-orchestrator now; other Python repositories only when deterministic invariants justify it
capabilities.benefit: Generate and shrink edge cases that example-based unit tests may miss.
capabilities.evidence: Property tests protect fail-closed required-check states and terminal CI failure classification in tests/test_decision.py.
capabilities.promotion_rule: Add to another repository only with at least one valuable property/regression test; do not add an unused dependency.

capabilities.scope: repositories where existing linters/type checks leave a demonstrated class of security/correctness gaps
capabilities.benefit: Additional static-analysis rules for security and correctness.
capabilities.promotion_rule: Run locally/advisory first; require in CI only after signal quality and Actions runtime cost are measured.

capabilities.scope: containers, dependency/configuration surfaces, and repositories with an observed scanning gap
capabilities.benefit: Vulnerability, secret, configuration, and container scanning.
capabilities.promotion_rule: Do not duplicate an already effective repository security lane without evidence of added coverage.

capabilities.benefit: Automated update PRs and vulnerability-driven dependency maintenance.
capabilities.promotion_rule: Service Dependabot PRs under ordinary DoWork P1-P4 rules; never auto-merge red or materially uncertain updates.
Keep local/advisory for private repositories unless a clear gap justifies CI integration.
